The steps to answer your question are as follows:

1.  **Country hosting the 2024 Summer Olympics:** The 2024 Summer Olympics were hosted in Paris, which is in **France** (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Summer_Olympics).
2.  **Capital city:** The capital city of France is **Paris**.
3.  **Current Mayor (as of April 2025):** The current mayor of Paris is **Emmanuel Grégoire** (https://apnews.com/article/paris-mayor-emmanuel-gregoire-socialist-b487efda02134f1312c349d1c89bee21).
4.  **Party Leader:** Emmanuel Grégoire belongs to the Socialist Party (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Socialist_Party_(France)). According to the Socialist Party's leadership history, the current first secretary (party leader) is **Olivier Faure** (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Socialist_Party_(France)).

The party leader of the political party that the current mayor (Emmanuel Grégoire) belongs to is **Olivier Faure**.
